blocker.detail: The hardened push-triggered carrier produced no durable handoff while the branch remained at its carrier head. Connected GitHub exposed no combined status and its available commit-workflow lookup exposed no run; that lookup is limited to pull-request-triggered runs, so authoritative push run/job IDs and logs are unavailable to this worker.

If the matrix passes, submit A2 and activate A3. If execution or a browser command fails, commit exact evidence and keep the earliest bounded repair ready.
